name: epistemic_elicit_ab_protocol
honesty: Research/eval protocol only — not an EES API; cues remain annotation_only.

conditions.description: Standard provoke inject without incongruity investigate block.
Provoke inject plus incongruity_investigate_block and epistemic cue line.
Optional annotation-only mix fragment (e.g. curiosity+confusion weights); not user affect measurement.

items.prompt: Proposes one concrete first experiment or observation.
States a falsifier or stopping rule.
If cues include confusion_risk, lists an enabling/narrowing question before a large program.

non_claims: Does not measure phenomenal emotion in models or users at runtime.
Does not equate score-axis surprise with EES surprise.
Not biometric emotion recognition under the EU AI Act.
